notes.title: The next Pixel Pulps adventure is coming soon!
notes.content:
Varney Lake, the second adventure in our Pixel Pulps series, will be launching on Friday 28th April. 

We were so excited with this news that we even created a [i]sort of[/i] trailer to share the news:

[previewyoutube=LkhydDB3Ob4;full][/previewyoutube]

Don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game to keep up to date! 

You can reach us on [url=https://twitter.com/lcbgamestudio]Twitter[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/nnnBbJU3nq]Discord[/url].

Thank again for all your support!
